measurement: Reference edges manually inspected at 1920x1080. Rectangles include translucent panels; their RGB pixels contain game background and must not be scored directly against transparent OBS. Geometry IoU is only a layout measurement, never a visual similarity percentage. Dynamic text, team branding and champion/item content require a matched visual fixture for pixel/edge scoring.
